sources.entry: Shifter - A simple, self-hosted file-sharing web app, powered by Django. MIT Docker

summary.one_liner: Shifter is a simple self-hosted file-sharing web app built with Django and Tailwind CSS that lets you upload files and share download links.
summary.what_it_does: Shifter lets users upload files through a web interface and share download links with others. Multiple uploaded files can be bundled into an automatically created zip archive. Files are deleted automatically once they expire, and uploaders can manage their files and delete them early. Multiple accounts can be created so others can upload, and an admin interface controls site settings such as maximum file size and expiry time. The README describes it as built with Django, Tailwind CSS with Flowbite components, Docker, FilePond and JSZip. It defaults to SQLite and can be switched to PostgreSQL.
use_cases: Share large files with others via download links
Bundle multiple files into a single zip download
Let team members upload files to a shared server
Automatically expire and delete shared files
how_to_run: Copy the example docker-compose.yml into your project directory
Copy the .env EXAMPLE file to .env, set DEBUG=0, and replace CHANGEME values
Set SHIFTER_URL in .env to match your deployment
Visit the configured port and create an admin user on first visit
notable: Automatic zip creation when multiple files are uploaded
Files expire and are deleted automatically
Admin settings for maximum file size and expiry time
Optional PostgreSQL backend instead of default SQLite
Development mode via Docker with a superuser auto-created from env variables
caveats: README states the project is still in development and may not be suitable for production; features are incomplete and may change without backwards compatibility
docker-compose.yml still requires config files from the repository with specific relative paths
